items.heading: Tave Kosi
details: Key ingredients: lamb, rice, yogurt, eggs, flour
Brown lamb pieces with rice in a baking dish.
Bake covered until the lamb is tender and the rice has absorbed the juices.
Whisk yogurt with eggs and a little flour into a smooth sauce.
Pour the yogurt sauce over the lamb and bake uncovered until golden on top.

items.heading: Byrek
details: Key ingredients: phyllo dough, spinach or cheese, eggs, oil
Layer sheets of phyllo dough in a round pan, brushing each with oil.
Spread a spinach or cheese and egg filling between the layers.
Top with more phyllo sheets, tucking in the edges.
Bake until the top is crisp and deeply golden, then slice into wedges.
